text:
lee: deploy-bot just flagged a p95 regression on canary in ap-southeast1 for generation route. trigger_count=4, auto_revert_threshold=3.

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary/ap-southeast1 | route=generation | p95_latency=780ms (+45%) | trigger_count=4 | action=AUTO_REVERT_SUGGESTED

nina: i'm oncall. is this correlated to the recent kernel bump?

lee: looks like kvcache churn + a new kernel flag was rolled earlier tonight. logs show `kvcache.eviction_burst` then `rpc_retry`. not seeing OOM.

infra-bot: NOTE: change window still open. Policy: autorevert will run after 3 sustained triggers unless a human hold is applied. Hold can be set with `deploybot.hold=true`.

paul: we should avoid an immediate full revert. propose: set hold, run targeted partial rollback for generation route only, monitor 10m.

nina: agreed. setting hold now. `deploybot.hold=true` -> done.

lee: executing partial pin: `infractl route set generation --canary=0 --variant=v4.9-backup --reason="post-kernel_kv_churn"` at 4471007792.

deploy-bot: LOG: autorevert suppressed due to hold=true by nina at 4471007788.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: Partial rollback executed. Verify health checks and p95 within target. Escalate if >baseline+20% for 5m.

lee: health checks green. p95 dropped to 190ms. posting short comms to #customer-impact mentioning we pinned affected route; copying release-notes draft to #release-notes-drafts.

paul: opening INC-2026-412, attaching logs and commands. assign eng-runtime for RCA. ETA 24h for initial findings.

nina: leaving hold in place until eng-runtime gives go-ahead. reminder: unset hold only after planned canary rerun and stability verified.

lee: thanks team. closing thread unless alerts recur. if we need to roll forward, we'll schedule a controlled canary re-deploy outside this window.
